body:
Fixes context-overflow handling in the authenticated private Swift service. Genuine prompt token-capacity overflow keeps its typed classification and returns HTTP 413 with `context_length_exceeded` before generation. Unknown failures remain fail-closed. Rejected counts invalidate stale prepared requests and permit a healthy owner to count and generate again without automatic replay.

Includes the existing Windows ARM64 and x64 CPU executables and matching integrity receipts, built from exact source `9e8ea3e2c042ab0c3f1a8e9596ff155e202c3c57` with the pinned nightly-2026-10-22 compilers. Dependencies, notices, CPU arithmetic, model/adapter identities, memory reserves and defaults are unchanged.

PTQ1 and adapters remain explicit selections. This release does not qualify an application default, full-model numerical parity, provenance, performance, quality or owner comfort.

Owning exact-source checks:
- [Foundation](https://github.com/symbiogenesis/prism-inference/actions/runs/41580496421)
- [Runtime conformance](https://github.com/symbiogenesis/prism-inference/actions/runs/41580660471)
- [Source package](https://github.com/symbiogenesis/prism-inference/actions/runs/41580658543)

The attached archives and receipts are unchanged from the owning Foundation run. Registry publication remains separate.
name: Prism Inference 0.1.14
